title: MemoryError while exporting the monthly report (index.rebuild)
body:
## Environment

Lattice version 3.3.7; operating system Windows 11 24H2; server region eu-
west-2.

## Steps

Steps to reproduce:
* With the log window open, start exporting the monthly report.
* Run the same input in a loop for several hours.
* Wait for the failure and read the log.

## Expected

No traceback; exporting the monthly report normally takes a few seconds.

## Actual

Memory grows a little on every run of the same input and eventually fails. The
same input succeeds on a fresh start and fails after a few hours of repeats.

## Frequency

Reproduces twice this week.
stacktrace:
lattice/ui/main.py:49 in loop
lattice/report/schedule.py:64 in run_due
lattice/report/builder.py:140 in build
lattice/store/index.py:156 in rebuild
MemoryError: unable to allocate 3.1 GiB for index buffer
